name: Mudlark
summary: Ideas pipeline for a pottery studio: idea funnel, scoring matrix, product trials and kiln log
about: A complete ideas and product-trials app for a small maker business, shown with a pottery studio's sample data. Ideas move from a first thought through sketch, prototype and trial to launch, with scoring, costing per piece, team votes, real shop trials and a live kiln firing view. Good for a pottery, candle, soap, jewellery or any small product studio.
how: Overview pours clay pebbles through the idea funnel and lists the strongest ideas. Press Pour again to replay it.
On Pipeline, drag an idea to the next shelf. Moving into Trial checks the score gate and asks before starting a weak idea.
On Matrix, drag an idea up for more impact or right for more effort to rescore it, or focus a dot and use the arrow keys.
Open an idea to tune impact, effort and fit sliders, work out the cost per piece and margin, and add files and notes.
On Trials, log sales and returns, see daily sales, then end the trial with Launch, Rework or Drop.
On Kiln, start a planned firing and watch the temperature climb live, then cool. Settings holds costing rates, the gate and Reset demo data.
